blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: RLE — Encode repeated runs with counts.
dictionary coding — Represent repeated strings by references.
dictionary — Mapping of codes to values/phrases.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: Run-length encoding replaces each maximal run of the same symbol with a value and count; it works best for long consecutive repetitions.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: Dictionary coding replaces repeated strings with dictionary references; the decoder needs the same dictionary, transmitted or reconstructed according to the scheme.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Overhead matters. Alternating characters can make naive RLE larger; long repeated phrases can be valuable for dictionary coding.
